temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara notices Shirley's somber demeanor and hears Shirley say it has been tough and that she keeps wondering if more could have been done; Shirley also says it is hard to let go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knows their mutual patient died and that Shirley cared for him, but she has not yet confirmed how deeply Shirley is affected.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara's suspicion that Shirley is deeply affected is confirmed and deepened; she now sees grief and possible self-questioning.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is grieving and struggling to let go, and may be questioning whether more could have been done; she needs comfort and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort Shirley and reassure her that they provided good care and brought moments of joy.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara brings up treatment decisions and learns Shirley explicitly feels responsible for the outcome and wonders if pushing for a different approach might have helped; Shirley says the reassurance is hard to accept.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving and may be carrying guilt or self-doubt about the patient's death and treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Shirley's sense of responsibility and burden is confirmed and made more explicit.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley feels personally responsible for the outcome and is burdened by it; Sara believes this burden should not be carried alone.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility by discussing the decisions and reassuring her, and support her in processing the burden.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara observes Shirley continuing to be reserved and minimally expressive, then confronts her quietly; she learns Shirley holds back feelings because she fears seeming unprofessional or weak, and Shirley may try to be more open after Sara's reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving and feels responsible, and that she may be suppressing her emotions, but Sara does not yet know Shirley's reasons.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara learns Shirley's specific fear of appearing unprofessional or weak and that Shirley may be willing to open up.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley needs reassurance that expressing emotion is healthy and not a sign of weakness, and she may try to be more open.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to express her feelings and reassure her that showing emotion is healthy, especially among friends.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara reflects that her previous confrontation may have been too harsh; Shirley says it was a bit much but that Sara meant well, appreciates the apology, and wants to keep talking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara worries she may have overstepped or damaged the friendship by confronting Shirley too strongly, though she wanted to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara learns Shirley was somewhat overwhelmed but not alienated, and that Shirley values the apology and continued conversation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The friendship is intact or being repaired, and Shirley is receptive to ongoing support through talking.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Apologize, mend the friendship, and remain available and supportive in whatever way Shirley needs.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After some time, Sara notices Shirley's demeanor has improved; Shirley says she is feeling better because of their talks and Sara's support, and she accepts Sara's suggestion to spend time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley has been grieving and feeling responsible, and has been trying to be more open; Sara hopes her support is helping but has not yet confirmed sustained improvement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes — Sara's hope is confirmed: Shirley is improving, their talks and support are helping, and Shirley is open to a closer, out-of-work friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is doing better and values Sara's support; Sara can continue supporting her and deepen their friendship outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Shirley and plan to spend time together on the weekend.
